title: Nourishing Savory German Ground Beef Casserole
description: A cultured and crumbly German dish featuring tomato sauce and deglaze-fond, perfect for a crowd, this recipe is also anti-inflammatory-friendly. It combines ground beef, vegetables, and spices for a hearty meal.
instructions: Preheat the oven to 350 degrees Fahrenheit.
In a large skillet, cook the ground beef over medium-high heat until browned, breaking it into small pieces as it cooks.
Add the chopped onion and carrot to the skillet and cook until the vegetables are tender.
Stir in the tomato sauce and beef broth, bringing the mixture to a simmer.
Reduce the heat to low and let the mixture simmer while preparing the potato topping.
In a large bowl, combine the sliced potato and a pinch of salt and pepper, tossing to coat.
In a greased 9x13 inch baking dish, create a layer of the meat mixture.
Top the meat layer with a layer of potatoes, overlapping the slices slightly to cover the entire surface.
Repeat the layers, ending with a layer of potatoes on top.
Bake the casserole in the preheated oven for 45 minutes, or until the potatoes are golden brown and the casserole is hot and bubbly.
